label: Every caused moved mover of another is moved in some respect relevant to that moving
paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the scope bridge b3573a61-ec8b-5aba-8b5f-f1d03611e7f6 restricted to caused movers. If y, whose being some other thing causes, moves x (distinct from y) in respect r and is being moved in some respect, then it is being moved in some respect relevant to that moving. It is the conclusion of the proposed unified derivation from 631e014f-685d-434c-86b7-4a683a507b4d, d791628f-72c6-572e-ad1e-03f4f22ba646, 0628359b-4a71-5c67-a84b-0fd80104aceb and 7bf380c6-fcdd-4b14-bae5-d5a5acdebd5c (scratch-checked, zero axioms, not registered). With the separate input that a mover nothing else causes is moved in no respect, it gives b3573a61 classically.
